sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: The Qwen3‑4B‑Instruct‑2507 is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual instruct language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. Unlike the base Qwen3‑4B, this variant has only instruct training without thinking mode support.

sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.
